title: Bemerged
summary: Combine your pieces, plan your board, and turn small upgrades into powerful combinations. A Tower-inspired puzzle built around the next clever merge.
about: Combine your pieces, plan your board, and turn small upgrades into powerful combinations. A Tower-inspired puzzle built around the next clever merge.
An independent mini game inspired by The Tower. Play the browser version, or explore the rest of Tower Arcade for another kind of challenge.

features.title: Combine pieces
features.text: Turn matching pieces into stronger combinations.

features.title: Plan the board
features.text: Leave room for the merges you want to make next.

features.title: Think ahead
features.text: Build a strategy around the pieces available to you.

steps.title: Read the board
steps.text: Look for pieces you can combine.

steps.title: Drag to merge
steps.text: Drag a piece onto a compatible piece to combine them.

steps.title: Plan another move
steps.text: Consider the space and combinations your merge leaves behind.

controls.action: Drag to merge · mouse or touch
Use the game’s menus to start a run and see its available options.

availability: Available to play in your browser on desktop and mobile. The Play button opens the game.
controlNote: The game’s own controls and menus provide any additional bindings.
